gloss: photogenic quality; how well something photographs

definitions.gloss: photogenic quality; how good something looks in photos or on screen
definitions.explanation: The quality of looking good or impressive when photographed or filmed. Describes how well a subject's appearance translates to photographs, video, or television.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}は{写|うつ}り{映|ば}えがいい。
{写|うつ}り{映|ば}えを{意識|いしき}して{盛|も}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I plated the food with photogenic appeal in mind.

examples.japanese: SNSでは{写|うつ}り{映|ば}えのする{写真|しゃしん}が{多|おお}くの「いいね」を{集|あつ}める。
examples.english: On social media, photogenic pictures collect many 'likes.'

notes:
Composed of {写|うつ}り (how something appears in a photo/on screen) and {映|は}え (shining, looking impressive — the same {映|は}え as in the popular word インスタ{映|ば}え). The reading changes to ばえ through rendaku.

This word predates the social media era but has gained renewed relevance with Instagram culture. While インスタ{映|ば}え specifically refers to looking good on Instagram, {写|うつ}り{映|ば}え is a more general term for photogenic quality that applies to any photography or filming context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写|うつ}り{映|ば}えがいい: to be photogenic; to look good in photos
- {写|うつ}り{映|ば}えがする: to be visually striking in photos
- {写|うつ}り{映|ば}えを{気|き}にする: to care about how one looks in photos
- {写|うつ}り{映|ば}えを{意識|いしき}する: to be conscious of photogenic appeal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- インスタ{映|ば}え: Instagrammable — specifically for social media
- {見|み}{栄|ば}え: visual appearance; outward show — how something looks in general, not limited to photos
- {写|うつ}り{具合|ぐあい}: how something comes out in a photo — more neutral, describing the result rather than the appeal
